summary: ChatGPT is **seen but not cited**: **#5** on visibility (**39.1%**, avg position **3.8**), yet **openai.com** is only the **#5** cited domain (**804** cites) — behind **reddit.com** (7,238), **youtube.com** (4,609) and **medium.com** (1,731).
Owned domains are just **1.2%** of all citations; **social (26%)** and **earned media (15%)** carry the category. The category is won on third-party surfaces, not our own pages.

Visibility by topic is wildly uneven — strong on **Pricing (75%)**, **Writing (75%)** and **Privacy (74%)**, but it collapses on **Reasoning (46%)**, **Coding (32%)** and **API (25%)**. The technical topics are the gap.
**162** prompts already rank well but barely get cited, concentrated in **API and Coding** — a ready-made build/refresh queue.
Owned-citation share sits near **1% on every engine**, thinnest on **Google Gemini (0.8%)** and **Perplexity (0.9%)**, while **2,524** distinct fan-out queries remain unclaimed surface area.

actions.text: build content briefs for the **citation-gap prompts** in **API and Coding** — high visibility, weak citations.
refresh under-cited **owned pages** (openai.com, chatgpt.com) so engines cite us over **reddit/youtube/medium**.
lift owned-citation share on the weakest engines: **Google Gemini (0.8%)** and **Perplexity (0.9%)**.
